name: V21.geographic-dim
description: Brief 44 PR 44.1 — geographic dim substrate. A risk with state='WI' rates 1.10 via lookup.direct against a table keyed on the state value. The engine treats `dimension_type='geographic'` identically to a categorical dim at lookup time — Brief 44's geo_* substrate (geo_granularity / geo_scope / geo_territories) is authoring-surface metadata, not new runtime semantics. This fixture proves the engine accepts plans authored with the new substrate and produces deterministic output. STATUS: ✓ runtime-compatible — no engine changes required; UI surfaces (wizard + editor) land in PR 44.2-44.7.
